# PandaEMU documentation instructions

Use these rules only when asked to generate documentation, notes, repository maps, or learning aids.

## Documentation goals
Produce practical orientation material that helps a human understand:
- where major systems live
- which files or directories own which responsibilities
- important classes, methods, managers, configs, and SQL areas
- which areas are dangerous to modify
- what is confirmed by the repository versus what remains uncertain

## Required style
- Prefer concise, high-signal documentation.
- Organize by subsystem and path.
- Name concrete files, classes, methods, configs, or SQL locations when known.
- Clearly mark assumptions or unverified guesses.
- Do not invent architecture, call chains, or ownership.

## Useful documentation outputs
- repo map
- subsystem map
- playerbot orientation notes
- combat / spell / aura entry-point notes
- build and config notes
- SQL ownership notes
- "where to look first" learning guides

## Prohibitions
- Do not write fictional or generalized engine explanations detached from this repository.
- Do not present assumptions as facts.
